Biography & Background

About Me

My name is Ahmad Ananda Bagus Wicaksono, and I come from Karangsono Village, Kanigoro District, Blitar Regency, Indonesia. I attended SMKN 1 Blitar (State Vocational High School 1 Blitar), majoring in Telecommunications, Network, and Computer Engineering (TJKT).

I was active in the Student Council, serving as the Extracurricular Activities Coordinator. Through this role—starting in my first year (10th grade)—I learned about teamwork and organizing events, ranging from small-scale activities to large-scale ones, such as the school anniversary celebration of SMKN 1 Blitar. Furthermore, I learned how to manage my time effectively and gained valuable insights through networking and developing strategies to address and resolve various challenges.

In addition to my involvement in the student organization, I completed an internship at the sugar factory PT RMI, located in Rejoso Village, Binangun. During my five-month tenure in the Information Technology (IT) division, I acquired a wealth of knowledge and gained invaluable experience that has proven to be highly beneficial.
